name: Swipe Card Stack
description: Full-screen dark stage with a stacked deck of image cards that you drag upward to cycle, while the title and tag beside it update to the top card.
contents: Left text block with tag, large title and a meta footer line
Stack of image cards with depth scaling and fading
behavior: Drag the top card upward past a threshold to throw it and send it to the back of the deck
Cards behind scale down, shift up and fade by position
Title and tag update to the current top card
Below the threshold the card springs back
Layout stacks vertically on mobile and goes side by side from md
editableByProps: Number of visible cards and drag distance needed to cycle

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the depth look of the stack

fixed: Fills the viewport height as a full-bleed section
Card size is fixed at 280x380 on mobile and 320x440 from sm
Dark card border and shadow styling is built in
